name: Funnel Analysis
description: Builds conversion funnels from event data: users reaching each ordered step within an optional time window, conversion, drop-off and time between steps, per segment.
introductoryText:
Measures a conversion funnel from raw event data: how many users reach each step (for example *view product, add to basket, begin checkout, purchase*), where they drop off, and how long each step takes.

- Steps are listed in order; event names are matched ignoring case. Other events are ignored.
- **In order**: a step only counts if it happens after the user reached the previous step (untick to count any order)
- Optional **time window**: every step must happen within N hours of the user's first step (for example 48 hours)
- **Segments** such as device or channel (taken from each user's first event) give one funnel per segment

**Funnel output**, per segment and step: users, conversion from the start, conversion from the previous step, drop-off and the median hours from the previous step.
**Users output**: one row per user with the furthest step reached, whether they converted, each step's time and hours to convert, for remarketing lists or deeper analysis.

options.name: user_field
options.title: User field
options.description: Identifies the person or session moving through the funnel.

options.name: event_field
options.title: Event name field
options.description: Holds the event names listed in the funnel steps.

options.name: steps
options.title: Funnel steps, in order
options.description: Event names separated by commas or ->, for example: view_product, add_to_basket, begin_checkout, purchase

options.name: ordered
options.title: Steps must happen in order
options.description: Ticked: a step counts only after the previous one. Unticked: any order.

options.name: window_hours
options.title: Time window (hours)
options.description: All steps within this many hours of the first step. 0 = no limit.

blockOutputs.label: Funnel
blockOutputs.tooltip: Per segment and step: users, conversion from start and previous step, drop-off, median hours from previous step.

blockOutputs.label: Users
blockOutputs.tooltip: Per user: segment, steps reached, furthest step, converted, step times, hours to convert.
